label: rem:knot-operator-energy-vanishing
title: Vanishing locus and cheap/expensive operators
html:
Remark (vanishing locus and cheap/expensive operators).

Vanishing locus. The set \{q \in Q : E(\lambda, q) = 0\} is the LP boundary for partition \lambda. At these q-values, the operator \lambda becomes constraint-binding. Its inclusion or exclusion in the LP-dual basis switches. Crossing such a q-value marks a categorical phase transition for any atom whose NF includes operator \lambda.

Cheap and expensive operators. The 1-dimensional partitions (k), (1^k) satisfy w_\lambda/d_\lambda = 1/[k]_q!, so E(\lambda, q) = 0 identically. These operators carry no shadow-price weight and are always available. Only mixing partitions (d_\lambda \geq 2) possess nonzero E and contribute to the confinement filtration.
